meta.title: Sunnsteel — Train with a plan. Leave the math to Sunnsteel.
meta.description: A workout tracker where every set becomes evidence: plan, log, and watch records, ranks and your history grow. Free to start.

hero.headline: Train with a plan. Leave the math to <mark>Sunnsteel</mark>.
hero.subline: Build a routine, log every set, and let Sunnsteel calculate your progression, warm-ups, and plates as you train.
hero.phoneLabel: Example of a live workout in Sunnsteel

plan.title: Build your routine, or start from a template
plan.body: Weekly or rotating schedules and rep ranges that progress on their own. With Pro, 8-week blocks and planned deloads.
plan.callout: {template} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} a week

train.title: Load the bar without the math
train.body: Your last numbers beside every set, a rest timer that starts itself, and warm-ups and plates worked out from your working weight.

measure.title: Track your strength over time
measure.body: Track estimated 1RM, weekly sets by muscle, and body weight over time. Pro adds comparisons and training signals based on your logs.

earn.title: Records, milestones and ranks you earn by training
earn.body: Records come from your logged sets. Earn milestones and ranks by training consistently.

progression.title: Progress when you reach your rep target.
progression.body: When every set reaches the top of its rep range, your next workout adds one step—{step} by default. If you fall short, your weight carries over.

rest.title: Automatic rest timers
rest.body: The timer starts when you mark a set complete. With notifications on, it alerts you when rest is over, including when your screen is locked. On iPhone, install Sunnsteel to receive alerts.

supersets.title: Link exercises and train in rounds
supersets.body: Up to {max} exercises in a group, one set of each per round, each keeping its own weights and progression.

swap.title: Find an alternative exercise
swap.body: See alternatives ranked by movement and muscles worked. Your routine changes only if you choose to update it.

map.title: See your weekly training by muscle
map.body: View weekly sets by muscle on front and back body maps, plus estimated 1RM trends over time.
map.planLine: {free} weeks free, up to {pro} with Pro.
map.empty: No muscle has sets this week.

plateaus.body: See lifts with no new best in several sessions, along with the rule used to flag them.

signals.name: Training signals
signals.body: Compare effort, rep targets, declines, and workouts across the last two weeks and the two before.

deload.name: Deload suggestion
deload.body: If a load signal persists, Pro suggests a lighter week and shows the dates. Your plan changes only if you save it.

review.name: Training review
review.body: Choose a question and the workouts to review. Sunnsteel summarizes your logs and cites the numbers behind its answer.

ranks.heading: Ranks earned by consistency
ranks.body: Earn one of {count} ranks by completing workouts across different weeks. Your rank appears on your profile, and you choose who can see it.
ranks.requirement: {workouts, plural, one {# workout} other {# workouts}} in {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# different weeks}}

templates.heading: Start with a program
templates.body: Choose a starting template and edit it to fit your training. Add your working weights before you begin.

block.name: 8-week block
block.summary: Build an {weeks}-week progression for one lift, increasing from {first} to {last} of your reference max.
block.sets: Three working sets a week; in weeks 1 to 4 the last one goes to as many good reps as you can.

people.heading: Train with people
people.subline: All social features are included in the free plan.
people.name: Lucas

activity.title: Follow people and see them train
activity.body: See workouts, records, and milestones from people you follow. Choose from {reactions} reactions or leave a comment.
activity.entry: {name} finished {day} · {records, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}

partners.title: Train with partners
partners.body: Up to {max} partners. Each of you chooses what the other sees, and you can be told when a partner finishes a workout.

messages.title: Send what you trained
messages.body: Send routines, workouts, records, milestones, or a month of training in a one-to-one message. People you don't follow can message you only with a request, if you allow it.

privacy.title: You choose who sees each part
privacy.body: Set the visibility of each of {count} profile sections to Everyone, Followers, or Only me. Block accounts, report content, or export or delete your account at any time.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes. Logging, progression, your history, records, ranks and everything social are free, with no card. Pro is optional: {price} a month, with the first {days} days free once per account.

install.question: Is there an app for iPhone and Android?
install.answer: Sunnsteel is a web app you can install from your browser. On iPhone, open it in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, choose Install app from your browser menu. On a computer, use the install icon in the address bar. On iPhone, notifications work in the installed app.

beginners.question: Is it for beginners?
beginners.answer: Yes. Start with the beginner program or get a recommendation based on your schedule and goals. Sunnsteel also calculates warm-ups and plates. Pro adds training blocks and deloads.

progression.question: Does it tell me how much to lift next?
progression.answer: Yes. When every set of an exercise reaches the top of its rep range, your next workout adds one step, {step} unless you choose another; fall short and the weight you lifted carries over. Warm-ups and the plates for each side are worked out from your working weight.

customExercises.question: What if my exercise isn't in the catalog?
customExercises.answer: Create it. You can keep up to {customMax} exercises of your own and use them in routines and workouts like any other.

offline.question: Does it work offline?
offline.answer: If the signal drops mid-workout, keep logging: your sets are sent when it comes back, as long as the app stays open, and it tells you when changes are waiting.

pro.question: What does Pro add?
pro.answer: Pro adds 8-week and training blocks, planned deloads, workout comparisons and reviews, access to your full history, and routine drafts from a description. <link>See Free and Pro side by side</link>.

cancel.question: Can I cancel Pro at any time?
cancel.answer: Yes. Cancel in Settings under Account, or use the <cancellation>cancellation page</cancellation> without signing in. Pro remains active until the end of your paid period, and your account data is not deleted. Within {revocationDays} days of purchase, you can also use the <revocation>purchase revocation page</revocation>.

privacy.question: Who sees my profile and my workouts?
privacy.answer: You choose, for each of {count} parts of your profile: everyone, your followers, or only you. You can block anyone and report anything.

ai.question: What happens to what I give the AI?
ai.answer: Pro's routine drafts and training reviews send the text you provide—or the workouts you select—to Anthropic to generate a response. Sunnsteel does not store that content; it records that a request was made to track your monthly limit. Responses summarize your logs and do not diagnose.

data.question: Can I take my data or delete my account?
data.answer: Download all your data as one file from Settings at any time. Account deletion is immediate and complete.

closing.heading: Plan your next workout.
closing.subline: Start free in your browser. Available in English and Spanish.

footer.tagline: Train with a plan. Leave the math to Sunnsteel.
